District Announcement

Free meals for every student

Starting Monday, every HISD student eats breakfast and lunch at no cost — no application required.

       

Dear HISD families,

Beginning Monday, all students enrolled in Houston Independent School District will receive breakfast and lunch every school day at no charge. Your family does not need to fill out a meal application or send money to school.

Menus, allergen information, and serving times for your child's campus are posted on the Nutrition Services page. If you have questions, your campus front office is ready to help.

Starts Monday, September 8 — at every HISD campus.

See your campus menu
 

With appreciation,
HISD Nutrition Services

 

Houston Independent School District
